Le impostazioni di sistema di CielOS (le:
CielOS system settings (used by the Settings page; everything can be done from here too).
Choices live in ~/.config/cielos/sistema.json; from there comes ~/.config/cielos/hypr-sistema.lua (displays, keyboard,
mouse, advanced Hyprland options), loaded by the CielOS configuration. Every command answers in JSON.

  cielimposta stato                         everything: displays, input, audio, power, time, advanced
  cielimposta schermo NAME KEY=VALUE…       mode=2560x1440@165 scale=1.25 position=1920x0 transform=0..7
                                            vrr=0|1|2 (2 = fullscreen only) bitdepth=8|10 cm=srgb|wide|hdr
                                            mirror=NAME|"" disabled=0|1
  cielimposta schermo-annulla               restore the previous displays (after an unconfirmed test)
  cielimposta input KEY=VALUE…              kb_layout kb_variant repeat_rate repeat_delay sensitivity accel_profile
                                            natural_scroll touchpad.natural_scroll touchpad.tap_to_click
                                            touchpad.disable_while_typing numlock_by_default follow_mouse left_handed
  cielimposta avanzata KEY VALUE            any Hyprland option (e.g. decoration.rounding 8); empty VALUE removes it
  cielimposta audio uscita|ingresso NAME    the default device (output|input)
  cielimposta audio volume NAME PERCENT     (also @DEFAULT_SINK@)   ·   audio muto NAME 0|1
  cielimposta audio app ID PERCENT          a program's volume (sink-input)
  cielimposta energia PROFILE               power-saver | balanced | performance
  cielimposta ora fuso ZONE | ora ntp 0|1   (asks for the password, as always for the system clock)
  cielimposta sensori                       all temperatures, fans and power readings (hwmon), by name
  cielimposta genera                        rebuild hypr-sistema.lua from sistema.json
  cielimposta lingua it|en                  CielOS language (and other apps' from your next login)
Le ondate di CielOS, la parte senza root:
CielOS waves, the part without root: checks whether there's a new wave to offer, what it brings and what the
Arch news say. It installs nothing: the update is done by the guardian (action «aggiorna» with «ondata»), after
your password.

  cielondate stato                  current wave, update on trial, recent rollbacks
  cielondate controlla [--ritardo N] [--json]
                                    the proposed wave: the day N days ago (default 4), the packages that change
                                    (delicate ones highlighted: kernel, drivers, systemd…) and the news to read

A wave is offered only if it's newer than the current one, brings something, and doesn't contain a package at the same
version as one that made the system roll back (that one waits for a fixed release).

L'aspetto di CielOS da un posto solo.\n\:
CielOS appearance from a single place.

Your choices live in ~/.config/cielos/cielos.json (a few keys, all optional: the ones that aren't there
stay at their default). From there cieltema generates:
  - ~/.config/cielos/tema.json      the shell theme (the shell follows it: you see it right away)
  - ~/.config/cielos/hypr-ciel.lua  shortcuts, borders and gaps of Hyprland windows
  - with tema_app: the colours also for GTK apps (gtk.css) and the foot terminal; always: sddm.conf for the login
Every change first saves how it was (~/.local/state/cielos/tema-storia): «cieltema annulla» goes back.

  cieltema                          how it is now
  cieltema imposta key=value …      changes (e.g. accento=#7fd0ff raggio=20)
  cieltema togli key …              back to the default value
  cieltema preset [name]            a bundle of settings at once (base, pixel, compatto, morbido)
  cieltema tema [name]              the ready themes (notte, alba, bosco, ghiaccio, carta and the Archcraft ones:
                                    catppuccin, latte, dracula, gruvbox, nord, tokyonight, everforest, …)
  cieltema sfondo [file]            colours taken from the wallpaper (image or video; without a file: the current one)
  cieltema annulla                  back to how it was before the last change
  cieltema ripristina               everything at its default
  cieltema schema                   the keys, their limits and what they do
  cieltema genera                   redoes the files without changing anything (after an update)
  --json                            answers for programs (Ciel)
I plugin di CielOS (come il menu Install:
CielOS plugins (like Omarchy's Install menu): games, development, web apps, terminal programs,
services, communication, graphics, office. The catalog is in plugin/catalogo.json; installed ones in
~/.config/cielos/plugin.json. Every installation runs in a terminal: you see what it does, and you type the password.

  cielplugin                     the catalog (✓ marks installed ones)
  cielplugin elenco --json       the same, for Settings
  cielplugin installa ID…        install (in a new terminal if you're not already in one; --qui to do it here)
  cielplugin togli ID…           remove (packages needed by something else stay)
  cielplugin webapp NAME URL     your own web app: a single window for that site, in the app menu
  cielplugin script ID           the script it would use (to look at it first)

Install (the dashboard, Super+A), like Shelly: every source together.
  cielplugin cerca TEXT [--json]           Arch repositories, AUR (-git and -bin too) and Flathub, grouped by program
  cielplugin versioni repo|flatpak NAME    the versions you can choose (Arch: older ones too, from the archive)
  cielplugin pacchetto SOURCE NAME [VER]   install that variant (repo, aur, flatpak), even a specific version
  cielplugin installati TEXT [--json]      everything installed that contains those letters
  cielplugin aggiornamenti [--json]        what is waiting for an update (Arch, AUR, Flatpak)
  cielplugin dettagli SOURCE NAME [--json]  the details: description, sizes, dependencies, licence, last update
  cielplugin rimuovi SOURCE:NAME…          remove (never vital packages; those needed by others stay)
  cielplugin aggiorna-tutto                system (with waves and a snapshot), AUR, Flatpak and firmware

Hooks (like Omarchy's): executable files in ~/.config/cielos/hooks/EVENT/, run by cielos-hook
on the events tema (colors changed), accesso (at login), plugin (ID installed). For every other PC event
(games, USB drives, network, updates…) there are cield's automations.

The shell's dashboard (Super+A) uses these commands with --json; you can use them by hand too.

  cielmodelli hardware                    what this PC has (graphics card, RAM, models disk)
  cielmodelli motore                      Ollama: installed? on? with the right library for the graphics card?
  cielmodelli cerca TEXT [--fonte F]      search for a model (sources: huggingface, ollama; by default all allowed ones)
  cielmodelli dettagli SOURCE ID          a model's versions (quantizations), each with the estimate for this PC
  cielmodelli consigli [--rifai]          the recommended models for THIS PC, per use (chat, coding, images, reasoning): the most capable that stays smooth, and a faster one (from Ollama's library, with real sizes; one day in cache)
  cielmodelli installati                  the downloaded models: size, state, who uses them, estimate
  cielmodelli scarica NAME                download (e.g. hf.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF:Q4_K_M or qwen3:4b)
  cielmodelli scaricamenti                downloads in progress or recently finished
  cielmodelli annulla NAME                stop a download (it resumes where it was)
  cielmodelli spegni|accendi NAME         off: nobody uses it (Code doesn't offer it) and it leaves memory
  cielmodelli libera NAME                 remove it from memory now (it waits for Ollama to let go)
  cielmodelli elimina NAME                really uninstall it: first out of RAM, then delete the files (if it was Ciel's mind, Ciel is left without a mind)
  cielmodelli ciel NAME                   this model becomes Ciel's mind (Ciel restarts)
  cielmodelli impostazioni NAME [--json]  every setting for that model, with its default
  cielmodelli scheda NAME                 what Ollama knows about it: maximum context, layers, capabilities
                                          (vision, tools, reasoning), parameters it carries inside
  cielmodelli imposta NAME KEY=VALUE      change the settings (contesto=8192, temperatura=0.3, top_p=0.9,
                                          min_p=0.05, ripetizione=1.1, presenza=0, max_token=0, seed=1,
                                          strati_gpu=0, batch=0, mmap=si|no|auto, mlock=si|no|auto,
                                          ragiona=si|no|auto, memoria=sempre|default|no); «auto» = default value
  cielmodelli ricarica NAME               reload the model in memory with the new settings (if it was there)
  cielmodelli fonti [nome=si|no ...]      which sites may be used to search and download

The estimate ("does it run?", memory, tokens/s) is a calculation on memory bandwidth: a model that generates a token must read all its active weights once. Graphics card ~0.6 of theoretical bandwidth, RAM ~0.5 (calibrated on real Ollama timings: 128 GB/s of graphics memory and 35 GB/s of RAM on this PC). For MoEs only the active part counts (e.g. 30B-A3B: 3 billion out of 30). It is an order of magnitude, not a promise: real tokens/s also depend on context, batch and what the rest of the PC is doing.
Come sceglie le parole: temperatura bass: How it picks words: low temperature = predictable, high = varied. Top P and Top K limit the choice; Min P drops unlikely words.
Il modello ha %1 strati; quelli oltre la: The model has %1 layers; the ones beyond the graphics card go in RAM.
Il modello non riesce a uscire dalla mem: The model can't leave memory: try again.
Le impostazioni valgono al prossimo cari: The settings apply the next time it loads.
Lo usa Ciel: spegnerlo vuol dire spegner: Ciel uses it: turning it off means turning off one of her minds.
Ollama non ha KV cache, speculative deco: Ollama has no KV cache, speculative decoding, parallel slots, checkpoints or extra arguments: I don't show what doesn't exist. «Auto» restores the default.
Ollama non è installato: è il motore che: Ollama isn't installed: it's the engine that runs the models. This PC needs: %1
Quanti token il modello può leggere e ri: How many tokens the model can read and remember at once. Higher means more memory; the maximum is the one the model declares.
Strati sulla scheda video, batch, mmap/m: GPU layers, batch, mmap/mlock, reasoning: for those who know what they're touching.
Un conto, non una promessa: più contesto: An estimate, not a promise: more context (and more GPU layers) means more memory. The desktop keeps the rest.
«Sempre» lo tiene caricato anche quando: «Always» keeps it loaded even when nobody is using it; «5 minutes» is Ollama; «No» unloads it right away and won't reload by itself.
Massimo %1 token: è quello che dichiara: Maximum %1 tokens: that's what the model declares.
È la mente di Ciel: se la togli dalla me: It's Ciel's mind: if you unload it she has to reload it on every question. Pick «always» or «5 minutes».

The network of CielOS: Wi-Fi, cable, addresses and DNS for the whole PC. The engine is NetworkManager (nmcli);
the Settings (Super+I → Network) use these commands with --json, and they also work by hand.

  cielrete stato [--json]                    how the network is: Wi-Fi, cable, addresses, connections, DNS
  cielrete reti [--rescan] [--json]          nearby Wi-Fi networks (name, signal, security, which one is in use)
  cielrete connetti NAME [--password-stdin]  join a Wi-Fi network; the password comes from stdin, not from the
                                             command line (so it doesn't end up in «ps»)
  cielrete scollega NAME                     leave a connection (Wi-Fi or cable)
  cielrete wifi [on|off]                     turn Wi-Fi on or off; without: toggles
  cielrete dns [automatico|cloudflare|google|quad9]
                                             the DNS of the whole PC (the guardian asks for the password)

The DNS applies to every network: you choose it once and it stays even when you change Wi-Fi. «Automatic» puts back
what the network gives (DHCP). New networks need no reconfiguration: NetworkManager applies the chosen DNS to all
connections.
